headline: GPU rental prices held flat across all six tracked GPUs over the past 7 days; MI300X leads price-performance.
bullets: Every tracked GPU posted a +0% 7-day change in its market index, including B200 at $8.25, H200 at $5.40 and H100 SXM at $4.32.
MI300X offers the best price-performance at $3.62 per PFLOP-hour, just ahead of B200 at $3.67, while A100 80GB SXM is the costliest at $8.65.
H100 SXM carries the steepest hyperscaler premium at +162%, with a hyperscaler median of $10.68 against a neocloud median of $4.07.
Marketplaces remain the cheapest segment: Vast.ai lists H100 SXM at $2.40 and A100 80GB SXM at $1.12, and RunPod Community Cloud lists B200 at $5.98.
B200 has the narrowest hyperscaler premium at +77%, with a hyperscaler median of $14.12 against a neocloud median of $7.99.
watch: Watch whether MI300X, quoted by only 4 providers, keeps its price-performance lead over B200 as more providers list it.
